info.name: MMBCD Mammography Cancer Detection API
info.description: Production Enterprise Django REST API for Multimodal Mammogram Cancer Detection (FocalNet-DINO & MMBCD) under Strict Sequential VRAM Execution (Zero-Overlap Lifecycle).

formdata.value: 54yo female, palpable mass in right upper outer quadrant, dense fibroglandular parenchyma.
formdata.description: Patient clinical history / symptoms / clinical indication narrative
Number of top-confidence lesion candidate crops to extract and classify (default: 5)

request.description:
Performs two-phase multimodal deep learning inference:
1. DICOM preprocessing (VOI LUT windowing, tissue contour crop, normalization).
2. Phase 1 (FocalNet-DINO): Detects candidate lesion ROIs -> Complete VRAM flush.
3. Phase 2 (MMBCD): Cross-attends top-K ROI crops with clinical text -> Complete VRAM flush.
4. Returns comprehensive clinical diagnosis, ROI bounding boxes, probabilities, latency profile, and memory telemetry.
